The department may issue an authorization for temporary residence in accordance with Article 507 of Chapter 5 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code. An eligible basement or cellar residence in the program area shall comply with the provisions of such article and the rules of the department.
(L.L. 2024/127, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
